Chapter 271 Desert Battlefield

Under attack by Zerg Zerglings, the well-trained army of the aliens quickly took positions, and those troops responsible for vigilance were already fighting with the Zerg Zerglings.

The alien army had just formed a formation and was ready to deal a heavy blow to the Zerg Zerglings. More than 500,000 Zerg air mobile forces, mainly Zerg Dragons, flew over on time.

The Zerg host had already explored the details of the alien army. The Zerg Queen launched a spawning attack on the command level and strong men in the alien army from a long distance, paralyzing the command system and strong men of the alien army in one blow.

The Zerg Explosive Mosquito is now the suicide bomber of the Zerg air mobile force. The Zerg army does not have the ultra-long-range fire support of the Zerg Destroyer, so they are the best fire support force.

Hundreds of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes of various star levels entered the accelerated attack state, and rushed into the long-range attack type of soldiers of the alien army at a very high attack speed.

"Boom...!"

The violent explosion disrupted the formation of the alien army, and a large number of long-range attack soldiers were killed and injured.

The parasitic control of the Zerg Queen followed closely, and quickly parasitized and controlled a part of the high-killing efficiency soldiers in the alien army, and launched a counterattack against the alien army from the inside.

This caused the alien army to fall into a chaotic fight. The comrades who were once familiar with them suddenly became mortal enemies.

This kind of change is difficult for people with firm beliefs to bear. They fell under the blades of their comrades with a little hesitation.

The alien army lost its high-level commanders, and faced with such a situation of internal and external troubles, it quickly fell into a state of chaos.

More than 500,000 Zerg flying dragons and millions of Zerg puppies in the air launched a fierce attack on the alien army at the same time!

The alien human army, which fell into a state of chaos, could only fight on their own, and was quickly wiped out by the powerful aerial firepower of the Zerg Dragons and the fierce close combat of the Zerg Puppies.

The Zerg Queen did not parasitize and control too many enemies, and they just let the parasitized people and the enemies die together.

An asymmetric annihilation war ended, and the Zerg air mobile force did not suffer any losses. They immediately went to the next predetermined target.

The Zerg puppies on the ground had been fighting in close combat, and there were many casualties. They left the wounded to guard the spoils, and the other intact Zerg puppies scattered and continued to perform reconnaissance and clearing tasks.

According to this method, the Zerg air mobile force cooperated with the Zerg puppies to quickly clean up the remaining alien human army in the area around the 66th city.

The Zerg puppies and Zerg hosts have entered the range of other large cities.

The total strength of the Zerg puppies has exceeded 100 million, and their number is still increasing rapidly. They play an important role in the underground world, the 108th District of the Southern Theater Public Battlefield, and the Demon Territory.

In the Zerg First Branch Base under the 66th City, tens of thousands of Zerg puppies are hatched every moment and go to perform tasks.

At this rate of dispatch, the Zerg puppies will soon be all over the 108th District.

The Zerg ground main combat forces that continue to rest in the Zerg First Branch Base have no suitable offensive targets for the time being, so they can only stay in the base and waste combat power, waiting for the next war to come.

…

After these days of planning, the Naga tribe finally opened up another battlefield.

Wu Qing learned from the information collected by Host No. 3 that the original battle between the native camp and the evil god camp did not have a clear battle line to simply divide the world into two, and most of the battlefield locations were staggered.

Because of the existence of space transmission channels, many battlefields were opened in the territory of the enemy camp, and even in the hinterland of the enemy camp.

As long as the strength allows, it is possible to attack any place of the enemy camp.

The Naga tribe did not know what method they used this time to open up a desert battlefield. The Zerg host and Zerg destroyer led by Host No. 3 were teleported through a large space transmission channel, and they did not know where the desert was.

This was also the first time Wu Qing saw the desert environment in this world.

The high temperature and water shortage environment of the desert had no effect on the Zerg at all. The yellow sand everywhere was simply the Zerg's home court.

In Wu Qing's original cognition, he always thought that the Naga tribe lived in the water. Until he saw the Naga tribe in this world, he found that the Naga tribe in this world was different from what he knew. The Naga here seemed to be friendly to the earth element energy.

So in such a desert environment, the impact on the Naga tribe was also very small.

When Host No. 3 came to the desert, he found that there were many insects in the desert. The powerful insect control ability in the Zerg host gene allowed it to directly control a large number of insects in the desert.

The combat power of these desert insects was very weak and useless.

With the preliminary preparations of the Naga tribe, a desert city with a large space transmission channel has been initially built.

"No. 3, this is the territory of an ancient desert lord. It will not be invaded by strange creatures. Many desert races live here!"

"But this place was occupied by the evil god camp a long time ago!"

"Now the people living here are all races that believe in the evil god!"

"My race also obtained this space coordinate by chance, but it has never been used!"

"This time the clan was discussing the matter of opening a new battlefield, and this was one of the alternative targets. Finally, after careful consideration, the clan chose this desert area to open a new battlefield!"

"When the battlefield was just opened, our clan consumed a lot of luck and used the luck array to hide this place and quickly built this main city!"

"Tonight, our clan will stop consuming luck and hide here. At that time, the local evil god believers will come to attack!"

"It is still unknown what race our enemy will be, so we have transferred all of you here just in case!"

"..."

Nagaya explained to Host No. 3.

Nagaya has passed the assessment of the Naga clan and has officially become an important and powerful figure in the Naga clan. She is one of the main persons in charge of the opening of this new battlefield.

Therefore, she is very clear about many things about this new battlefield.

"No problem, we will do our best to assist the nobles in their defensive operations!"

Host No. 3 readily agreed. After being idle for so long, more than half a million Zerg destroyers were already looking forward to a big battle.

This is the first defensive battle for the Naga tribe's new battlefield, which is very helpful for Wu Qing to understand how to open a battlefield in this world.

In its initial state, the main city of the Naga Desert's new battlefield is not very large, which is conducive to initial defense.

After the Naga tribe has established a foothold here and built some satellite cities outside the main city to ensure the safety of the main city, they can continue to expand the main city.

Nagaya also told Host No. 3 these things without reservation.

The Naga tribe has been paying attention to the performance of the Zerg tribe on the public battlefield in the southern war zone. The Zerg tribe fought alone against the outer human race and defeated them. The Naga tribe was also one of the first major tribes to obtain this news.

When the Naga tribe chose to open up this risky desert battlefield, the Naga tribe's senior leaders took the Zerg factor into consideration.

If the difficulty of this desert battlefield is too high, you can consider bringing in the Zerg. Whether you continue to hire troops or directly invite the Zerg to join the battle, these are all feasible options.

Therefore, when Nagaya told Host No. 3 so much information, she also meant to ventilate the Zerg in advance.

After obtaining Nagaya's consent, Host No. 3 sent out all the Zerg hosts to collect various information in the desert area.

Through the analysis of the information collected by the Zerg host and combined with the defense needs of the Naga clan, the Zerg clan's more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers selected defensive positions in the main desert city of the Naga clan.

This is a sand dune highland in the center of the main city. Placing such a large scale of Zerg destroyers can provide fire support for the entire city.

Due to time constraints, the main desert city of the Naga tribe focused on building defensive facilities. There are very few buildings in the city, and the large sand dunes are still in their original state.

However, the area within the city has been transformed by the magic of the Naga mage. It seems that even the sand dunes have not changed. It is impossible for the enemy to attack from underground.

Tens of millions of elite troops from the Naga tribe and Naga-affiliated races gathered in the main desert city of the Naga tribe. They divided the defense zones and prepared for the upcoming war.

It was still early in the day, so the Naga tribe stopped supplying the hidden luck array, and a large city suddenly appeared in the vast sea of sand.

Tens of millions of elite troops gathered together, and the murderous aura that soared to the sky, without the suppression of the luck array, broke out in an instant, frightening all kinds of creatures around the main city of the Naga desert and quickly moved away.

All kinds of intelligent creatures living in the desert and believing in evil gods immediately took action and sent out scouts to check out the situation.

The main desert city of the Naga tribe should be located on the territory of the desert lizard tribe. The first people to arrive were various desert lizard people with strange evolutions.

The desert lizardmen are different from the green lizardmen of the bugbear clan. They have lived in a desert environment with scarce resources for a long time, which has allowed them to evolve thick scales and sharp claws.

Desert lizardmen are all sandy in color and are good at hiding in desert environments. They are naturally good at using simple sand magic. They are one of the most difficult races in desert areas.

This information was provided by the Naga tribe. The Naga tribe wanted to open up a new battlefield in the desert area, and they did their homework very well.

The Naga clan is a long-established clan. It is relatively easy to collect information about the desert area. This collection work is probably carried out when the spatial coordinates of the desert area are obtained.

The accumulation of so many years has made the Naga tribe very well prepared.
